effectRules: Stage membership is a current execution-order projection, not purchase authority.
Every exact transaction must refresh seller/price/stock/accessory/warranty/current-model facts immediately before payment.
A stage may be partially transacted if the exact consumer needs only a subset; do not buy the remainder merely to complete the stage.
Arrival creates provisional objects, not capability; post-arrival identity/binding/fitness/re-entry receipts remain mandatory.
Negative experimental results may change later staging and are not reasons to retroactively rewrite prior preregistration.

does not require all R1 groups to be purchased
does not make R2 part of first order
